Messages.Author: apathy
Messages.Body:
Under the NRA rule, can a minion use a Computer Hacking, untap
(through, say, Freak Drive or Earth Meld), then bleed normally?
IOW, does bleeding with a Computer Hacking count as that minion's
bleed action?

Thanks in advance.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <gZgD2.9918$Ge3.38...@news.itd.umich.edu>,

apathy <sky...@umich.edu> wrote:
> Under the NRA rule, can a minion use a Computer Hacking, untap
> (through, say, Freak Drive or Earth Meld), then bleed normally?
> IOW, does bleeding with a Computer Hacking count as that minion's
> bleed action?

From the DCI rules:

2.5.1 Repeat Actions
No single vampire may repeat an action, by action type, in a single turn.

Example: A vampire that successfully bleeds its controller's prey via
Computer Hacking, then untaps via Freak Drive, cannot perform any
bleeding action again, of any kind whatsoever, in that same turn.
